packageRules.description: msw pins its own @mswjs/interceptors range, and the repo's FetchInterceptor must match that copy's types, so the two update together. A major msw update and a minor interceptors update share one branch only when the group does not separate majors.

Hold msw below 3. msw 3 intercepts fetch at node:net, which Bun's own fetch never uses, so the test mock server catches nothing under Bun and the tests reach the real network. Lift this rule once msw's fetch interception works under Bun.

Hold @mswjs/interceptors in the ^0.41 range msw 2.15 depends on, since the msw group would otherwise bring 0.45 alone. A 0.45 FetchInterceptor fails the type msw 2's SetupServerApi takes, and msw intercepts nothing through it. Lift this rule with the msw hold.

Hold the kernel-builder stage of host/Dockerfile on Ubuntu 22.04. Its gcc 11 is the compiler kernel/config-base records, its apt sources name jammy, and a new compiler changes the guest kernel's bytes. Digest updates of 22.04 still come.
Every Go module here holds tool directives, and the go get -t ./... that Renovate runs loads none of their packages, so it leaves their module sums out of go.sum. go mod tidy adds them.
